d: In this video, you will learn how to build, analyse, and execute multi-leg option strategies directly from the Kite Option Chain using basket orders. Placing multi-leg options strategies like spreads, straddles, strangles, or iron condors requires executing multiple buy and sell orders in a specific sequence to optimise margin requirements. The option chain on Kite allows you to add individual legs directly to a basket, view required and final margin in real time, reorder leg execution to maximise hedge benefits, and analyse payoff scenarios before placing the complete trade.
